resources.string: Some saved data couldn\'t be read — restore from a snapshot or dismiss.
Set aside: %1$s. Nocturne kept the unreadable copies and is using defaults in their place. Dismissing this notice doesn\'t make an unknown slot safe to overwrite.
Nocturne couldn\'t finish writing a restore. Until it can, changes to profiles, settings, history and saved originals aren\'t saved.
Free some storage space, then reopen Nocturne. This notice stays until the restore is finished.
The saved originals of some BedJet slots couldn\'t be read. Slots with no saved original won\'t be written until you accept that those originals are lost.
Accept that these originals are lost?

The saved originals of some BedJet slots can\'t be recovered. If you accept, Nocturne can write those slots again. Whatever a slot holds at that point is saved as its original and marked as uncertain, because it may be one of Nocturne\'s own programmes. Every original saved from now on is marked uncertain too.
Your BedJet hasn\'t confirmed “%1$s” on slot %2$d. Check the BedJet, then mark it as checked.
